limits: Sampled images do not establish continuous contact-free duration, magnetic force or exact fingertip trajectories.
Three same-color squares do not establish unique physical panel serial identities or final body-face correspondence.
Closing the ring by folding retained joins is distinct from inserting three already oriented unconnected panels. A proposed alternative may not be described as observed source motion.
No simulation result, production stage edit, source-piece record, observation lock change or full source acceptance is supplied by this discovery.

reviewDisposition.status: Visual claims supported with explicit limits; production unchanged.
reviewDisposition.sourceHashLimit: The reviewer independently matched all five PNG hashes but looked for the video at a legacy example path and did not independently hash video bytes. The discovery now records the actual cached source path; the extraction process and current source evaluator each verified the recorded original SHA-256. Do not call the reviewer video-hash verification complete.
